thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: incident P-84912 triggered -> inference-gateway error-rate spike (5xx) in us-east1. Alert: 5xx-rate > 15% over 2m, total 5xxs = 18r/s. Auto-pager engaged. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P-84912 opened and paged the SRE rotation. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-84912 :rotating_light:

alex_v: ACK. I'm on call, looking now. @sam_sre can you pull graphs?

sam_sre: grabbing metrics from grafana and tracing. Initial check: surge started ~00:11 UTC, error spike concentrated on /v1/generate -> 502/503. Latency also up. I'm running `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"` against a few backends now.

sam_sre: quick checks:
```
# check pod restarts / evictions
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
# check logs for 502 patterns
kubectl logs -n inference deployment/inference-gateway --since=10m | tail -n 200
```

miguel_r: I saw something similar in canary earlier—possible kv-cache eviction flooding request fallback to CPU path. Also noticed two recent config pushes to routing weights ~00:05 UTC from ui (grace_runtime). @grace_runtime any chance weight changes landed at ~00:05?

grace_runtime: yep, I deployed a minor route weight tweak at 00:04:58 UTC to shift traffic from eu to us for a test. It should’ve been 10% -> 20% on us-east1. I don't expect it to cause 5xx but rolling back now.

priya_s: pagerduty-bot shows escalation queued at 00:18 if not acked by lead. Alex, do you want me to escalate to Eng Lead?

alex_v: hold on escalation. Sam, what's pod health?

sam_sre: pods are up but logs show a lot of "KV cache miss -> cold start" and downstream model pods returning 504 occasionally. I see connection resets from model-hosts pool. Running `kubectl top pods` shows one model-host node with high CPU.

sam_sre: output snippet:
```
NAME                                CPU(cores)   MEMORY(bytes)
model-host-7xk2                      2200m        14Gi
model-host-9plm                      85m          2Gi
inference-gateway-6b5c               320m         1.2Gi
```

miguel_r: that pattern matches a saturated model-host causing tail latency + retries -> gateway 502s. Two mitigations: 1) temporarily route traffic away from the hot model-host pool (weights) 2) scale model-host pool by +20%. I'm going to start #2 now.

miguel_r: scaling model-host pool up (triggered autoscaler override):
```
# override autoscaler to 160% for immediate capacity
kubectl patch hpa model-host-hpa -n inference -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}'
```

grace_runtime: rolling back my routing change to remove extra traffic from us-east1:
```
# rollback route weights
redwoodctl routes set --service inference-gateway --region us-east1 --weight 10
```

alex_v: good. Also let's mute noisy downstream retries in the gateway for the next 15m to avoid amplification. Sam, can you toggle retry policy?

sam_sre: toggling retry policy now (per runbook step 4).
```
# disable retries for 15m
redwoodctl config set inference-gateway.retry_policy.enabled false --duration 15m
```

pagerduty-bot: P-84912: Acknowledged by alex_v at 00:19 UTC. Escalation suppressed.

cs_eli: tagging customer-impact channels. I'll start drafting a heads-up for affected customers (likely small percent of traffic). Which customers are hitting the us-east1 route predominantly?

sam_sre: querying request logs for top callers. Short list: billing-service, search-indexer (internal), 3 enterprise customers (acme-corp, brightleaf, journify). acme-corp shows 12 failed requests in last 10m.

cs_eli: noted. I'll create a status message and prepare an Ops message for acme-corp.

miguel_r: model-hosts scaled to desired min replicas. Observing drop in CPU on the hot node as new pods come up and traffic rebalances.

sam_sre: after scale and rollback metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 18r/s -> ~3r/s in 6 minutes. Latency back to baseline for most requests. Still seeing a few 502s from journify traffic.

grace_runtime: confirmed rollback applied and route weights stable. :white_check_mark:

alex_v: nice work. Let's keep retries disabled for 10 more minutes, then re-enable slowly. Also documenting incident timeline in channel.

priya_s: reminder: log the PD incident and attach preliminary root-cause notes. I'll open the incident Jira and tag oncall.

priya_s: PD note: "mitigations: scaled model-host pool, rolled back route-weight change, disabled retries temporarily. Observed reduction in 5xx rate to baseline. Potential contributing factor: routing weight change + KV cache coldness causing hotspot on a subset of model-hosts."

pagerduty-bot: P-84912: Incident status changed to "under investigation".

sam_sre: small follow-up action: I'm going to scrub KV cache on the worked-over hosts to avoid repeated cold starts. Running cache warm-up job for top prefixes.
```
# warm cache for top prefixes
redwoodctl cache warm --service model-host --prefixes-file /tmp/top-prefixes.txt
```

miguel_r: running a health check script against a few tenants:
```
for t in acme-corp brightleaf journify; do curl -s -D- https://gateway.internal/$t/health | head -n1; done
```
All returned 200s locally.

cs_eli: Sent targeted note to acme-corp support alias and CSM. Template updated: "We're investigating intermittent 5xxs originating from us-east1 between 00:10-00:20 UTC; mitigation applied and monitoring. We'll follow up with full incident report."

alex_v: monitoring for 20 more minutes, then we'll unmute retries and start a handoff. If 5xxs stay under 1% for next 10m, I'll mark response as stabilized.

sam_sre: 5m check -> 5xx 0.8% now, errors concentrated on one journify gateway key. I've tied trace ids back to a retry storm from SDK 0.9.12 — journify's SDK has aggressive retry. Noted for postmortem.

priya_s: escalated to eng-lead as FYI (no action needed) and opened JIRA INC-84912 with mitigations + next steps.

pagerduty-bot: P-84912: Incident acknowledgment by alex_v. No further automatic escalations.

grace_runtime: re-enabling retries at reduced aggressiveness:
```
redwoodctl config set inference-gateway.retry_policy --backoff fixed --attempts 2
```

sam_sre: retries back on. Final check: 5xx steady at 0.4% over 10m window.

alex_v: declaring incident mitigated at 00:40 UTC. We'll keep monitoring and collect logs/traces for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :clap:

cs_eli: I'll follow up with customers and post a brief status update to status.redwood.ai noting mitigation and ETA for full report.

miguel_r: action items for postmortem (assigned):
- investigate whether route weight change + cache coldness can be prevented by staged rollout and cache pre-warm (miguel_r)
- evaluate autoscaler thresholds and HPA stability (sam_sre)
- contact journify about SDK retry settings (cs_eli + grace_runtime)
- add runbook step to temporarily mute retries earlier (priya_s)

alex_v: handoff: morning oncall @priya_s will take post-incident monitoring and own the follow-ups. Handoff at 06:00 UTC.

priya_s: taking handoff. I'll keep PD incident open and will file the postmortem draft tomorrow.

incident-bot: Note: this thread will be archived after 30d.
